summary: PM2c: bundled plugins and their marketplace updates
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub `852af1e`: PM2c: bundled plugins and their updates — plugin folders in plugins\ next to the app are bundled; of a plugin bundled and installed, the newer copy loads and only its folder (PluginFolders, Sdk.Core, tested; an update for another plugin API never hides the bundled copy); Marketplace page: Bundled / Update to / Back to / Remove Old Copy
